fields.description: Master switch for the Pine Labs integration.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Configure Pine Labs machines with their credentials. Mark exactly one as Is Default.
fields.label: Machines

fields.description: Single Machine: every transaction uses the row marked Is Default. Mapping: consults the Machine Mappings table below by context (user / warehouse / company / POS profile), falling back to Is Default when no mapping matches.
fields.label: Terminal Routing Mode

fields.description: Routing rules used when Terminal Routing Mode is Mapping. Each row says: when context X matches (User / Warehouse / Company / POS Profile), route to machine Y at priority Z. Lower priority wins; alphabetical tie-break on machine name.
fields.label: Machine Mappings

fields.description: Enable Plural payment-link generation. Required for the 'Send Payment Link' button.
fields.label: Enable Payment Links

fields.description: Use Plural UAT (sandbox) endpoints. Uncheck for production.
fields.label: Use Plural Sandbox

fields.description: Optional override. Leave blank to use sandbox/production defaults.
fields.label: Plural Base URL Override

fields.description: Plural webhook signing secret. Used to validate inbound X-Verify HMAC. Min 16 characters.
fields.label: Payment Link Webhook Secret

fields.description: Configure this URL in the Plural dashboard. Format: {site}/api/method/pinelabs_fin.api.webhook.handle_webhook
fields.label: Webhook URL (read-only)

fields.description: Document types that show the Pine Labs payment buttons. Payment Entry is not allowed here.
fields.label: Payable Doctypes

fields.description: Override Pine Labs API endpoints. Leave empty to use defaults.
fields.label: API Endpoints

fields.description: Verify TLS certificates on outbound API calls. Disable only for local simulators.
fields.label: Verify SSL

fields.description: Log full request/response payloads for every API call. Noisy; use only when troubleshooting.
fields.label: Debug Mode

fields.description: Auto-cancel pending transactions after this many minutes. Default 3 if 0/empty.
fields.label: Auto Cancel Duration (Minutes)
